description_en: Invokes the GetBasicAccelerateIpIdleCount operation to query the number of idle accelerated IP addresses of a basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用GetBasicAccelerateIpIdleCount接口查询基础型全球加速实例的闲置加速IP数量
kebab_example: aliyun ga get-basic-accelerate-ip-idle-count --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ip-set-id ips-bp11r5jb8ogp122xl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBasicAccelerateIpIdleCount

parameters.help_en: The region ID of Global Accelerator. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of a request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration region instance ID of the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance that you want to query.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253380.html to query the acceleration region instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的基础型全球加速实例的加速地域实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253380.html查询加速地域实例ID
parameters.name: ip_set_id

TotalCount.description_en: The number of entries returned, which indicates the number of idle accelerated IP addresses
TotalCount.description_zh: 列表条目数，即闲置加速IP的数量
